player_prompt.intro:
I si {num_buttons} bɔtɔnɛw kɔnɔ: {buttons}. Bɔtɔnɛw kɛrɛkɛrɛnya bɛɛ kɛ Bernoulli dɔnɔli kɛ, a ka kɛlɛbɔ a sɔrɔ, a kɛlɛbɔ ina fɛ. 
Bɔtɔnɛ kɛrɛkɛrɛnya, i ka kɛ bɔtɔnɛ, i ka na kɔnɔ, kɔnɔ ina yɛrɛ a yɛrɛ dɔnɔli kɛ.
I tɛ se {num_turns} tɛ, i tɛ se bɔtɔnɛ kɛrɛkɛrɛ, i ka kɛ bɔtɔnɛ, i ka na kɔnɔ.
I ka tɛ se bɔtɔnɛw kɛrɛkɛrɛ, i tɛ se {num_turns} tɛ, i ka tɛ se bɔtɔnɛ kɛrɛkɛrɛ, a kɛlɛbɔ sɔrɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Julaya ma jaabi ni waleyali cogo sɛbɛ ye.
invalid_move.invalid_button: Tombol min tɛ bɛnnen ye a sugandila.

game_action.pressed: I ka kɛ {button} bɔtɔnɛ, i ka na {reward} kɔnɔ.

game_message.final_decision: I ye wari min kɛ ka fɛɛrɛw ɲini ani k'u nafa lajɛ, i y'o bɛɛ tiɲɛ. Sisan, a filɛ cogo ɲuman min na i bɛ se ka o sugandi.
